reason_for_amendment: Pilot v3 selected 16 instances, but 50 otherwise ordered candidate-detail requests failed during a transient No route to host outage. No model call, container build, test execution, or Exhibit A verdict had occurred. Treating transport loss as corpus ineligibility would measure network availability rather than product coverage.

changed_collection_rule.applies_to: URL and timeout failures while reading public GitHub JSON
changed_collection_rule.exhaustion: After five failed attempts, record the candidate exclusion exactly as before.
changed_collection_rule.outcome_retry_distinction: These are pre-corpus metadata reads. The one-completed-attempt rule for Exhibit A outcomes is unchanged.

unchanged_selection.repository_frame: First 50 repositories accepted by the root pinned-environment parser, scanning at most 1,000.
unchanged_selection.candidate_search: First 100 merged-PR results per retained repository in the date window, sorted updated ascending.
unchanged_selection.bug_indicator: Exact case-insensitive bug label OR title beginning fix, fixed, fixes, or fixing.
unchanged_selection.claim: Verbatim PR title with no added expected signature
unchanged_selection.revisions: GitHub merge_commit_sha and its first parent
unchanged_selection.instance_checks: Commit date, production Python diff, accepted pinned environment on both revisions, resolvable Git relationship
unchanged_selection.candidate_order: merged_at ascending within repository, round-robin by repository star rank

unchanged_execution.sandbox: Docker, unprivileged, network disabled, credentials unavailable
unchanged_execution.outcome_retry_rule: One completed attempt per instance; record and resume only interrupted attempts.

unchanged_analysis.headline: VERIFIED divided by all 30 included instances
unchanged_analysis.cost: provider-reported only; unavailable is not zero
unchanged_analysis.interpretation: rank constraints and report all selection exclusions
